destinations.lead: Five cities, hand-picked homes. Choose a city to see our stays — each one books directly on Booking.com.

members.title:
Stay more.
Get more.
members.lead: Membership is complimentary for every OSTAY guest — and it pays off from your very first stay: a concierge on call, a stocked pantry, a fresh room and a night to share.

benefits.label: 01 · Daily concierge
benefits.title:
A local friend on call,
every day of your trip.
benefits.body: 9:00–22:00 daily. Check-in help, car arrangements, luggage delivery and ticket booking. Babysitting coming soon.

benefits.label: 02 · Local pantry
benefits.title:
Arrive to a stocked kitchen,
not an empty fridge.
benefits.body: A complimentary selection of local snacks and ingredients, waiting in your room on arrival.

benefits.label: 03 · Mid-stay clean
benefits.title:
Fresh sheets halfway through —
on the house.
benefits.body: One free room clean in the middle of your stay, so day five feels like day one.

benefits.label: 04 · Refer a friend
benefits.title:
Bring a friend.
Earn a free night.
benefits.body: When a friend you refer books 5 nights or more, you receive a voucher for one free night.

contact.title:
Let’s find your
next journey together.
contact.lead: Questions about stays or long-term options? We’d love to hear from you.

why.title: Three reasons to stay like a local.

items.label: Space
items.title: Room to Breathe
items.tagline: Generous space that gives your mind room, too.
items.body: Layouts with a place for everyone, even for a family of four — room for kids at play and for grown-ups unwinding on the sofa.
bullets: Living & dining for the whole family

items.label: City connection
items.title: In the Heart of the City
items.tagline: A base connected to the pulse of the city.
items.body: Step outside into the lively heart of town. Shop the markets, eat your way through the streets, and never worry about the way home.

items.label: Smart check-in
items.title: Seamless Technology
items.body: Skip the front desk and head straight to your room with a smart lock. Need a hand during your stay? We’re online anytime.

concierge.title:
Free to explore.
Safe to return.

points.title: 24/7 online support
points.body: Whenever you need help on your trip, reach us online anytime.

points.title: Safe, secure stays
points.body: We only feature residential hotels designed with security in mind.

points.title: Home-like comfort
points.body: Everything you need for daily life, from short trips to long stays.

points.title: Guest relations
points.body: From booking to check-out, we keep your journey running smoothly.

concierge.partner: We partner with trusted locals to make every stay safe and special.
